- 新增三平台本地 Agent 入口：GUI 安装包内含 CLI 与标准输入输出 MCP 服务，可接入脚本和 AI 工作流；可选 Skill 独立安装、升级。
- GUI／CLI／MCP 共用本机配置和证书，提供受控加固、独立签名及证书管理，GUI 无需常驻；密码不进入模型输出。
- 完善任务超时、取消、子进程清场和输出无覆盖提交，并改进 Windows Java 工具中文参数处理。
- Beta.2 改善 Linux 空白窗口兼容，保留用户显式渲染配置；普通签名增加暂存、V4 附件协同提交及失败回滚，并补齐三平台接入文档。Windows Java 8／17 已完成专项验证，Fedora 实际反馈环境仍待确认。
- 本次为 Beta 预览，保留 `1.4.3` 最新稳定版。Agent 受控签名暂限 V1–V3；具体命令路径、授权范围与接入方式见 [Agent 接入说明](https://github.com/mocikadev/mocika-shield/blob/v1.5.0-beta.2/docs/ops/agent-setup.md)。不改变 Android 支持范围或壳加载策略。

- Added local Agent interfaces on Windows, macOS, and Linux: GUI installers bundle a CLI and stdio MCP server for scripts and AI workflows. The optional Skill is installed and updated independently.
- GUI, CLI, and MCP share local settings and certificates for controlled protection, standalone signing, and certificate management without keeping the GUI open. Passwords are not exposed to model output.
- Improved task timeouts, cancellation, child-process cleanup, no-overwrite output publication, and Chinese arguments passed to Java tools on Windows.
- Beta.2 improves Linux blank-window compatibility while respecting explicit rendering settings. Regular signing now stages outputs, publishes V4 sidecars together, and rolls back failed commits. Cross-platform setup documentation was updated. Windows Java 8/17 checks passed; the reported Fedora environment still awaits confirmation.
- This is a Beta preview; `1.4.3` remains the latest stable release. Controlled Agent signing currently supports V1–V3. See [Agent setup](https://github.com/mocikadev/mocika-shield/blob/v1.5.0-beta.2/docs/ops/agent-setup.md) for paths, host permissions, and integration. Android support and runtime loading remain unchanged.
